description: This PHP source file defines a class 'mbinfo' that reads system monitoring data from a CSV log file ('MBM5.csv') and provides methods to retrieve temperature, fan, and voltage information.

classes.name: mbinfo
classes.description: A class for parsing MBM5 CSV logs to extract system temperature, fan, and voltage data.

methods.name: temperature
methods.description: Reads temperature sensor data from the CSV log and returns an array of temperature readings with labels, values, limits, and percentages.

methods.name: fans
methods.description: Reads fan speed data from the CSV log and returns an array of fan readings with labels, values, minimums, and divisions.

methods.name: voltage
methods.description: Reads voltage sensor data from the CSV log and returns an array of voltage readings with labels, values, minimums, and maximums.
